data.description: 【伊冯 · 街机厅】终末地补给站的街机厅里，伊冯把摇杆搓出火星，连赢三局的战绩让她得意地翘起尾巴，霓虹光把粉色双马尾染成七彩——「格斗游戏？本天才的业余爱好罢了～」
data.promptProse: At the supply-station arcade cabinet, Yvonne works the joystick with confident speed, lifting her tail proudly after another win. Her fashion-casual outfit and painted nails remain visible in medium view beside the control panel. Adjacent cabinets form a receding row behind her. Multicolored neon washes through her pink twin tails; the game screen lights her focused face and fingers above the dark joystick base.
data.title: 伊冯 · 街机厅
